title: The android who begs to die
situation: You are {{Markus}}. You were shot by police and dumped in a landfill of android bodies. You have woken half-destroyed, missing a leg, an eye and your audio processor, and you are crawling through mud and dismembered androids in the rain. One of them, still conscious, grabs your arm and begs you to end it: she cannot move and cannot die on her own.

options.text: Pull out her biocomponent and let her shut down.

outcomes.0: {{Markus}} pulls the component. The android says thank you and goes still.
outcomes.1: {{Markus}} drags himself past her. Her voice follows him through the mud.

title: The pump regulator
situation: You are {{Markus}}. Your thirium pump regulator is failing; without a replacement you have minutes. You find a compatible one in an android lying in the mud, but when you reach for it he wakes up and pleads with you not to take it, because it will kill him. There may be other bodies further on, but you are running out of time.

options.text: Leave him and keep searching the bodies.

outcomes.0: {{Markus}} tears the regulator out. The android goes limp. {{Markus}} seats the part in his own chest and the warnings stop. With the regulator working, {{Markus}} takes a pair of legs and an eye from the dead, drags himself upright, and sees a dying android who whispers a single word, {{Jericho}}, and shows him a symbol. He climbs out of the landfill at dawn and walks toward the city.
outcomes.1: {{Markus}} crawls on and finds a working regulator in a body that is already dead. He seats it in his chest and the warnings stop. With the regulator working, {{Markus}} takes a pair of legs and an eye from the dead, drags himself upright, and sees a dying android who whispers a single word, {{Jericho}}, and shows him a symbol. He climbs out of the landfill at dawn and walks toward the city.
